input.quote: Payments to Licensor Fee rate per US$1million traded (for each one-way part of the trade)
input.rationale: The Article V fee construct is purely usage-based and meets our preferred position: Licensee pays a declining rate per US$1 million actually traded on the Platform, with the Monthly Notional Volume bands operating only as a volume discount (p0057-p0063, p0066-p0067) rather than as a floor. There is no minimum volume, no committed spend and no take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic anywhere in the document - searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "take or pay" return nothing relevant, and p0070 measures the amount payable by reference to volume actually recorded as traded with the Licensed Technology. The 36-month Initial Period (p0049) is a licence term only and carries no purchase obligation, so no reduction or exit right is required under this rule. The other Licensee payments are for ordered items rather than minimums: the $35,000 Initial Payment already advanced (p0051), the $2,500 per month Technical Support Services fee (p0086, with p0089 confirming no further support charges), and Supplemental Payments that are a 33% share of amounts Licensee actually earns from third parties (p0078). The Licensor-side rebate commitment (p0076) runs in our favour and is not flagged. No redline needed.
